title: Comments in HTML
summary: HTML comments look like <!-- this --> and are invisible in the rendered page. Use them to explain structure or temporarily disable markup.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: HTML comments look like <!-- this --> and are invisible in the rendered page. Use them to explain structure or temporarily disable markup.
Comments never reach the browser's visible output but ARE sent to the client — never put secrets or sensitive notes in them.
Key points: comments cannot nest, they can wrap whole sections, and conditional comments for old IE are obsolete.
